react.description:
MenuGroup renders a group of menu items with persistent styling.
It is primarily used to apply grouping logic or context to its children.

tags.devx: Groups related MenuItem children and inherits the parent Menu variant.
tags.a11y: A visible `label` names the semantic group; an unlabeled group is presentational.

className.name: className
className.description: Classes or state-aware element classes applied through the shared style contract.

variant.name: variant
variant.description: Overrides the color treatment inherited from the parent Menu.

label.name: label
label.description: Visible and accessible label for the group.
